title: Alert routing and notification
requirement: Route alerts from the local metrics and logs to the workstation's user, with grouping and silencing, without a paid service.
a_deciding_comparison_would_measure: Delivery of a fixed set of firing and resolved alerts to the user's devices, duplicate suppression, and behaviour across a restart.
target_hosts: Primary: a new WSL2 Ubuntu-family instance on a Windows workstation, x86_64, 48 cores, 104 GB RAM, NVIDIA RTX 4090 24 GB. Secondary: macOS arm64 laptops. Users: Claude Code and Codex agent sessions on that host.
